theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_sc_cone_simons_defect
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, 0 < (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) → 2 * (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 / ‖x‖ ^ 2 + (∑ k : Fin P, (fderivWithin ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν z ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M z)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))) ^ 2) / 4 ≤ (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) * (∑ i : Fin P, ∑ j : Fin P, ∑ k : Fin P, (inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2)
